rules.text:
per claim per side: paired over seeds (treatment arm vs control, same side). OK = sign matches direction AND z in the direction >= 3 AND |rel| >= 5 %. gankShare is null when the side made no gank in that phase; valid pairs < 200 on either side => unmeasurable (no fallback registered). Guard: ganksPerMin.

of the same side must not fall (z <= -3 AND |rel| >= 5 % on either side => guard_failed); a guard with < 200 valid pairs on either side makes the option unmeasurable (it never passes silently). A share rise with total ganks flat is the intended tilt (fewer ganks elsewhere); the guard catches a share rise produced by total ganks falling. A strong-side option needs BOTH phase claims on BOTH sides. Precedence: unmeasurable > reversed > guard_failed > confirmed > one_sided > insufficient.

consequences.confirmed: the per-phase focusLane value (and the quick-mode strong side for that lane, if its own option is confirmed) becomes offerable in a separate commit with gates; evidence scope is balanceTool.v21, std template; a lane confirmed on one side only stays design

controlSymmetry.rule: contract §4.4: gankShare is counted in own-lane names, so the control arm's blue and red means should be close. |red - blue| > 0.10 on any listed metric => flag CONTROL_ASYMMETRY in the result; verdicts are still computed and recorded, but no C5 option is promoted until the instrument is checked and the check is documented.
